reason: Line limit is expressible: select_when selects the last character (regex `(?s).\z`) gated by exists `\A(?:[^\n]*\n){N}`, which is exact. The only miss is a fixture that turns the rule off with a `tslint:disable` comment.

evidence.why: `/* tslint:disable:max-file-line-count */`: TSLint suppresses, Rerail does not
